Activate

  1. Install GNARL from the zip (its README says where).
  2. Open it in your DAW and tap LICENCE in the panel's header.
  3. Paste the key. It works on three of your own machines.

Audio never depends on the licence. Offline, GNARL keeps working for 30 days before it asks again.
